adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then calls `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no clamping/validation. In Ruby, `"-1".to_i` becomes `-1`, so requests like `?offset=-1` (and similarly negative `limit`) can flow into the SQL `OFFSET -1`, which Postgres rejects, likely raising an exception and producing a 500. This behavior is introduced/expanded by the diff because pagination now applies generally, not only for automatic groups.
